title: Convergent construction of N-terminally modified CCL5 chemokines for photoaffinity receptor pull-down using cross-aldol bioconjugations
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,1772-1778
DOI: 10.1039/D5CB00162E, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Afzaal Tufail, Matthew E. Warnes, Nathalie Signoret, Martin A. Fascione
Herein we demonstrate the use of an organocatalyst-mediated protein aldol ligation (OPAL) to construct modified CCL5 chemokines bearing a photoaffinity handle which can be used to pull-down CCR5 receptors from mammalian cells.
